name: ga4gh-security skill
summary: Mount the GA4GH Passport and GA4GH Crypt4GH plugins together and report which GA4GH security-domain standards this composition bundles
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Passport and Crypt4GH (composed), shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-security` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Mount the GA4GH Passport and GA4GH Crypt4GH plugins together and report which GA4GH security-domain standards this composition bundles. Use when the user wants both GA4GH Passport visa validation and GA4GH Crypt4GH header inspection mounted from one plugin, or asks which GA4GH security standards a deployment supports.
